T9 has a private receipt directory but no SHA256SUMS digest yet, so it is recorded under live_test_observations and not in first_live_tests_run. Raw responses stay private under STATE_ROOT/profiles/

/live-tests/; this file holds test ids, receipt digests, the lab Mac's journal lineage digests, CLI commands without ids, codes, field names, booleans, counts, durations and short notes only; clock times are left out (run_date gives the day).

limitations: T1 used the delayed key and read no market data. T9 used the live key: one live order, the fixed probe, cancelled in full with nothing matched; no strategy order and no open position.
T1 is one login, keepAlive and logout on one account on one day, from the lab Mac; it shows behaviour seen, not a documented guarantee.

The T1 receipt was written by lab-Claude from the command's printed output, not by the command; this report does not say which lines of the output the receipt keeps. Who writes receipts on the lab Mac is open for Yu (docs/betfair-pilot-1-plan.md, Architecture).
The offline doctor lines come from lab-Claude's session, from a run made before T1; this report does not say whether the T1 receipt also holds them.

T9 has no SHA256SUMS digest yet, so it is not in first_live_tests_run. Its codes come from lab-Claude's notes of the day (the probe ran in Yu's terminal) and from the offline doctor and status run after it, not from its receipt files, which no agent read.
The refused T9 attempt sent nothing; its codes come from the same notes.
The T0 notes are an observation, not a receipt.

The code is c86764a, main on that day. This report was written on the branch of PR #59 at 25c1341 and extended to the whole day on top of 91a3a29; that branch's code differs from c86764a in wording only: a comment in cli.py, one handoff string in pilot_run.py and a comment in the recording plist template.
Raw responses and the receipts stay private; only the SHA256SUMS digest, the journal lineage digests, commands without ids, codes, booleans and counts are here.
